title: The Best Workout App in the World
body: Update, June 24, 2026 - I’ve been using this app for a while and I like it even more than when I started.  One of the rare and fantastic things about the workouts is that they are genuinely well thought out, really nicely put together.  It seems a person sat down and thought this through and put the exercises in the right order and the most beneficial exercises.  So, there are no surprises.  The workouts do what they say they will do.  Anyway, I do wish they’d put out some new PROGRAMS, though I’m sure at some point they will.   ———-         I am absolutely crazy about this app.  It has everything, almost (no tai chi, yet).  All types of exercises and yoga . . . Of various lengths.  I am on a 30 day dumbbell program right now.  The variety of exercises in that one program is amazing.  I’ve never seen some of those moves.  Also, doing a 7-minute workout in the morning; love those unique moves, too.  Basically, you get this and you don’t need anything else.  I downloaded dozens of workout apps and this is the one who stood out way, way above the others; nothing even compares. Totally love it!
